Our deployed 00:05 PT launch model, which also knows the hunter, makers and team history, scores 50 / 58 / 73 live over 10 days. Who hunts it and who shows up on the day decide most of the result.
band|ph.input_note: Scored from the description you pasted with a model trained on Product Hunt launch descriptions. Tested only on launches it had not seen: rank correlation 0.35 on 856 Sep–Nov launches (0.42 on the 130 most recent), with the real rank inside the band about 3 times in 4.
